blindChoice.reason: Before public matchup information exists, both guides default to going first.

allowedWhen: The opponent archetype was made public by an earlier game in the match
The lab explicitly labels the run as known-matchup analysis
prohibitedWhen: The scheduler knows the opposing list but that fact has not been disclosed to the acting player
The preference depends on cards revealed only after the opening choice

cardReferencePolicy.executableSpecialistReference: The card ID must exist in the specialist's frozen main manifest.
cardReferencePolicy.executableOpponentReference: The card ID must exist in the in-scope opponent's frozen main manifest.
cardReferencePolicy.historicalReference: A missing or superseded card must be executable=false and include a reason.

required: Every new principle has guide page citations
